description: Remove a memory from the focus buffer. The memory is not deleted — it just stops being pinned to context.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that the memory has been removed from the focus buffer
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Removing a memory from the focus buffer
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFocusedError: the memory is not currently in the focus buffer.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the memory_id is correct and is currently focused.
